## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the recitation of the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī*. Where the five Táng translations [KR6j0144](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0144)–[KR6j0148](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0148) give the *sūtra* text containing the *dhāraṇī*, Amoghavajra's T972 gives the **ritual framework** within which the *dhāraṇī* is to be recited — the *mudrā*-mantra-visualisation triplets, the offering sequences, and the meritorial-soteriological dedication.

**Abstract**

The text codifies the daily-practice and ceremonial-occasional *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī* recitation in the Táng Esoteric ritual framework. As a working liturgical manual, it became the standard reference for the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya* practice in both the Táng Tángmì tradition and the Japanese Shingon-Tendai derivatives. The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Cháng'ān period (746–774).
